title: Penthouse Magazine April 2007 Dita Von Teese Complete w/ Centerfold Tony Soprano
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no visible creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, April 2007 issue, original $7.99 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover: Dita Von Teese - "Dita Opens Up: See What Manson's Missing." Also: Throwing Down with New York's Hottest Party Girls; the Real Tony Soprano; Balls Out MLB preview; 10 Ways to Kick Ass in the Kitchen; High-Def Jam format war; Hog Wild: the world's deadliest pig hunter; Big Boi, Good Charlotte, Young Buck.

Back cover: Evan Williams bourbon ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
